analysis.title: Duttenhoefer's Daily (06.11.2026)
key_insights: US equities sold off sharply on Thursday: S&P 500 closed at 7354 (+7.4% YTD) and Nasdaq -6.4% (+4.6% YTD). More than $2.5trn of US equity value was erased, SOX fell 12%, and over 100 S&P stocks fell more than 5%.

VIX rose 70% to 28, the biggest daily gain since Feb 2018. The US 10yr yield was 4.83%, Brent $99, gold $4047 and Bitcoin $75k. The author describes the move as leverage colliding with a sudden shift in market sentiment.
Nikkei and Kospi both fell about 6% in Asian trading. Attention turns to the AI debate and today's NFP report.

GS equities desk: Wednesday was one of its busiest days of the year by trade count and notional, while Thursday was the opposite. Phone calls for color were heavy but high-touch activity was much quieter. Price action was likely driven by top-down pressure through macro instruments, with massive notionals traded across the ETF complex. ETF volumes were 32% of the tape.

Gina Hinojosa (Texas governor-elect, Democrat) said all currently permitted data centers can finish construction, covering essentially all of 2027 and likely well into 2028. She plans laws requiring newly permitted data centers to pay taxes, commit to no consumer power price increases and not reduce water availability. The author says this sounds more reasonable than many headlines.

Yassamin Ansari (Arizona) called for a pause on advanced AI development, tighter regulation and a ban on artificial superintelligence, and urged Democrats to prioritize it. Her X post went viral and Musk replied 'Brave new world'.

Lloyd Blankfein argued that US industrial capacity has eroded for decades and that data center and AI leadership can reverse it, calling efforts to block all projects a gift to China. The author wonders how the data center debate will evolve if Deepseek releases a new model and open-source data show a continued shift away from the US.

Nvidia is pursuing a plan to convert existing telecom facilities into small AI data centers to deploy chips faster and avoid local resistance. It approached Apollo about a network that could span up to 20 US states, centered on buildings owned by Brightspeed (Apollo-backed).

Hyperscaler debt issuance equals 36% of GS equity research's aggregate 2026 Capex forecast, above the initial expectation of 33% debt-funded. This partly reflects a pull-forward of planned 2027 supply, and GS sees scope for more front-loading of issuance.

GS cut its end-2026 gold forecast to $4,150/toz from $4,650 and its end-2027 forecast to $4,800/toz from $5,400, citing the Fed's hawkish shift for positioning. It keeps a constructive long-term view on central bank demand, and expects further price support once the Fed starts easing in 2027H2 (economists expect cuts from late 2027 through early 2028).

Russia's foreign ministry reiterated its advice that citizens avoid travel to Iran because of the risk of renewed escalation, and Putin met Iran's security council chief in Moscow. The author says the headline drew attention but the travel warning is not new.

GS estimates that states where Democrats are likely to further restrict data centers hold about 45% of planned US data center capacity, with Texas about 25%. GS expects the issue to fade in importance and any moratoria to be short-lived, since data centers rank low among voter priorities.

market_movers.rationale: Nvidia is pursuing a plan with Apollo to turn Brightspeed telecom facilities into small AI data centers across up to 20 US states, to deploy chips faster and avoid local resistance.
Meta said US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar. The note reports this as news with no rating or view.

tension_points.bull_case: GS expects the issue to fade because data centers rank low among voter priorities, and moratoria to be short-lived. Hinojosa would let all permitted data centers finish, covering essentially 2027 and likely well into 2028. Blankfein calls blocking projects a gift to China.
tension_points.bear_case: States likely to restrict data centers hold about 45% of planned US capacity, Texas about 25%. Ansari called for a pause on advanced AI development and a ban on artificial superintelligence, and her post went viral.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A new Deepseek model and open-source data showing a continued shift away from the US could change how the data center investment debate evolves (the author's view).
